human_gate: None for isolated reproduction. The absence of another supported interpreter is reported as unavailable, not inferred.
objective: Independently reproduce the frozen HCJC commit's declared CI checks in an isolated worktree and classify evidence without modifying source or claiming production health.

skills.name: aai-cognitive-interface
skills.terminate_when: The A2 report is validated, persisted, and returned to A0 with one exact gate or blocker if needed.
skills.why: Controls custody, artifact validation, evidence boundaries, and the execution trail.

skills.name: code-verification
skills.terminate_when: Each declared check is passed, failed, or blocked with exact environment and command evidence.
skills.why: Supplies an independent CI-reproduction method, failure taxonomy, and evidence matrix.

skills.name: agent-churn-control
skills.terminate_when: Every repeated local check is either reused, invalidated for a named reason, or recorded as a distinct attempt.
skills.why: Gates any equivalent retry so a result is not repeated until green.

terminate_when: The bounded A2 work card is complete and only its report and non-sensitive audit trail are persisted.
